summary: AISDLC-484 PR-side lane classifier (commit dd4940bb4) weakened the trust chain without a record

options.description: Keep the shipped classifier until AISDLC-969 restores the control
Revert or gate the classifier immediately; AISDLC-969 restores the control

body: Retroactive record. The PR-side lane classifier shipped in dd4940bb4 and decides the docs-only lane from the PR diff, loosening the attestation requirement for PRs it classifies as docs-only. No decision record was filed at the time. The restoring task is AISDLC-969 (classifier runs from the base sha, not the PR tree).
